brief:
Pro-Palestine demonstrations across Morocco are exposing a widening divide between public sentiment and official policy, Al Jazeera English reported. Citizens have taken to the streets to challenge the Rabat government's deepening diplomatic and economic ties with Israel, a relationship that has accelerated since Morocco's 2020 normalization agreement.

The protests reveal strong grassroots support for Palestinian causes even as the government moves closer to Israel. The demonstrations reflect broader regional tensions as Arab states navigate competing pressures from local constituencies and international actors.
dek: Protests across Morocco highlight gap between public opposition to normalisation and Rabat’s closer ties with Israel.
title: Moroccan protesters oppose government's Israel normalization
